Resolves #20575

🌿 A Workstation grid can no longer select a row, or band a header group, in the theme's colors.

Workstation's palette bridge (`resources/scss/src/apps/workstation/Viewport.scss`) gains two mappings:

- **Selection.** All ten grid selection tokens map onto signal washes a step above the hover's 10%: a selected cell 30%, a selected row 22%, the row or column around a selected cell 16%. Text is ink.
- **Header groups.** The header tokens also land on `.neo-grid-header-group-row`. Its cells read the leaf headers' tokens by design (`grid/header/GroupRow.scss`), and the bridge had declared them only on `.neo-grid-header-button`. The glyph rule stays button-only.

The palette-bridge census, `WorkstationPaletteBridgeNL`, carries the ten selection tokens, and its `readPalette` reads `--workstation-ink`.

Evidence: L2 (browser e2e plus a computed-style probe in Workstation Pro) → L2 required. Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `WorkstationPaletteBridgeNL` resolves every selection token to the palette composition on a real `.neo-grid-cell`, in both skins and in the pop-out vessel. Outside-CI red run: on `dev`'s SCSS, three of its four tests fail on the first selection token |
| AC-2 | Outside-CI probe in Workstation Pro's pivot (the engine Workstation has no header groups to observe). The group cell's background was `rgb(24, 36, 73)` (neo-dark's `#182449`) in dark and `rgb(93, 131, 167)` (`#5d83a7`) in light. At the head it resolves to `--workstation-panel-2` in both skins: `#1a212c`, `#f7f9fc` |
| AC-3 | `WorkstationPaletteBridgeNL` + `WorkstationGridDragProxySkinNL` + `grid/HeaderGroups`: 19 passed at the head. The visual suite is 3/4. Its one red, `preview-language-pair-light` (528 px), fails identically on `dev` (a pre-existing neo-light arm, logged as a defect note); the Workstation dark preview pair passes |

## Deltas from ticket
- AC-1 named the Live Event Stream as a frame. The feed inserts about ten rows a second at its top, which scrolls a selected row out of its three visible rows before a frame can land. The Workstation Pro matrix, also a Workstation grid, carries the selection frames instead, and the census arm covers every Workstation grid.

## Test Evidence
BEFORE/AFTER frames of Workstation Pro, in the dark and light skins (selected row, and the pivot's header band), went to the operator. Pushing them to a media branch of this repository was refused. The probe and the census arms above carry the measurements.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [x] Workstation Pro on engine `dev`: the pivot's header band and a selected row read in the instrument palette in both skins. ✅ 2026-11-07 on `dev` `bc8a8c1bcb`: the band resolves to `--workstation-panel-2` (`#1a212c` dark, `#f7f9fc` light), and a selected row in the light skin paints the signal wash.
